instance.description:
# Welcome to Windows 7 🎥💻

Welcome to **Windows 7**, a video-sharing server inspired by the classic Windows 7 era! Remember the days of the Aero Glass interface, the iconic startup sound, the blue desktop wallpaper, and the golden age of the internet? This server brings that nostalgic feeling back with a place to watch, share, and discover videos.

Windows 7 is all about combining the nostalgia of classic computing with the freedom of online video sharing. Whether you're into gaming, entertainment, technology, animations, reactions, tutorials, or creative projects, there's a place for you here.

🖥️ **What to expect:**
- 🎬 Video sharing and discovery
- 🎮 Gaming videos and gameplay
- 📺 Entertainment, reactions, and creative content
- 💻 Retro technology and Windows nostalgia
- 🌐 A community-inspired video experience
- 📼 A throwback to the classic internet era

Our goal is to create a familiar, nostalgic environment inspired by the look and feel of Windows 7 while enjoying the modern world of decentralized video sharing through PeerTube.

So sit back, enjoy the classic vibes, discover something new, and make yourself at home.

**Windows 7 — Bringing the nostalgia of yesterday to the video-sharing world of today.** 💙

# Windows 7 — Terms of Service

**Last Updated: October 27, 2026**

Welcome to Windows 7, a video-sharing server powered by PeerTube and inspired by the classic Windows 7 era. By accessing or using this server, you agree to follow these Terms of Service. Please read them carefully before creating an account, uploading videos, or interacting with other users.

## 1. Acceptable Use

You agree to use Windows 7 responsibly and respectfully. You may not use this server to engage in illegal activities, harass other users, distribute malicious software, or interfere with the operation of the service.

## 2. User Accounts

You are responsible for maintaining the security of your account and the activity performed through it. Please provide accurate information when registering and do not impersonate other individuals, organizations, or server administrators.

We reserve the right to restrict or suspend accounts that repeatedly violate these terms, subject to applicable law.

## 3. Video Uploads and Content

Users are responsible for the videos, thumbnails, descriptions, comments, and other content they upload or publish.

You must have the necessary rights or permissions to upload and share your content. Do not upload copyrighted material without authorization, illegal content, or material that violates another person's rights.

Windows 7 does not claim ownership of content uploaded by its users. You retain your rights to your own content, subject to the permissions necessary to operate and display it through the service.

## 4. Prohibited Content and Behavior

The following activities are prohibited:

- Harassment, targeted abuse, threats, or bullying.
- Spam, scams, phishing, and deceptive content.
- Malware, harmful files, or attempts to compromise the server.
- Content that unlawfully infringes copyrights or trademarks.
- Illegal content or content that exploits or endangers others.
- Impersonation of administrators or other users.
- Attempts to disrupt, abuse, or gain unauthorized access to the service.

Additional restrictions may apply where required by law or established by server policies.

## 5. Copyright and Takedown Requests

If you believe content hosted on Windows 7 infringes your copyright, contact the server administrator with details identifying the material and your rights to it.

We may review reports and remove or restrict access to content when appropriate. Repeat copyright infringement may result in account restrictions or termination.

## 6. Privacy

Your use of Windows 7 may involve the processing of account information, uploaded content, technical logs, and other data necessary to operate the service.

We will handle information in accordance with applicable privacy laws and any privacy policy provided by the server. Because PeerTube is a federated platform, some public information and content may be shared with other connected servers.

Do not publish private or confidential information that you do not want made public.

## 7. Moderation and Enforcement

Windows 7 administrators may review reports, moderate content, remove videos or comments, restrict access, or suspend accounts when necessary to protect the community and enforce these terms.

Moderation decisions will be made at the administrators' discretion, subject to applicable law. Users may contact the administrator to ask questions about a moderation decision.

## 8. Service Availability

Windows 7 is provided on an as-available basis. We cannot guarantee uninterrupted access, permanent storage, or the availability of every feature.

The service may be updated, temporarily unavailable, or discontinued. Users should maintain their own backups of important content.

## 9. Third-Party and Federated Services

Windows 7 uses PeerTube, which may interact with independently operated servers and third-party services. We do not control every external server, its content, its policies, or its availability.

Content from other servers may be subject to their own rules and moderation practices.

## 10. Changes to These Terms

These Terms of Service may be updated as the server evolves. Updated terms will be published on this page with a revised date. Continued use of the service after changes take effect constitutes acceptance where permitted by applicable law.

## 11. Contact

If you have questions, concerns, or reports regarding these terms, please contact the Windows 7 server administrator through the contact method provided on the server.

instance.code_of_conduct:
# Windows 7 — Code of Conduct

**Last Updated: October 27, 2026**

Welcome to Windows 7! 💙

Windows 7 is a video-sharing community inspired by the classic Windows 7 era. Our goal is to provide a welcoming, enjoyable, and respectful environment where users can watch videos, share their creativity, discover new content, and connect with others.

By participating in this community, you agree to follow this Code of Conduct.

## 1. Be Respectful

Treat other users with kindness and respect. Everyone should feel welcome to participate, regardless of their background, interests, experience, or creative style.

Disagreements are normal, but personal attacks, insults, harassment, and targeted abuse are not acceptable.

## 2. Keep the Community Safe

Do not publish or promote illegal content, credible threats, malicious software, scams, or content that puts others at risk.

Respect the privacy and safety of other users. Never share someone's private information without their permission.

## 3. Share Content Responsibly

Before uploading a video, make sure you have the right to share it. Respect copyright, trademarks, and the creative work of others.

Use accurate titles, descriptions, and thumbnails. Do not mislead viewers, impersonate creators, or repeatedly upload spam.

## 4. No Harassment or Hate

Windows 7 does not tolerate targeted harassment, bullying, stalking, threats, or hateful attacks against individuals or groups.

You are welcome to express opinions and disagree with others, provided you do so without abuse or intimidation.

## 5. Respect Content Boundaries

Label sensitive or mature content appropriately and follow the server's content rules. Do not post prohibited material or attempt to bypass moderation restrictions.

Users are responsible for ensuring their uploads comply with applicable laws and server policies.

## 6. No Spam or Platform Abuse

Do not flood comments, repeatedly post unwanted advertisements, manipulate engagement, distribute phishing links, or exploit bugs to disrupt the server.

Do not attempt unauthorized access to accounts, administrative tools, or server infrastructure.

## 7. Respect Creators and Their Work

Give credit where appropriate and obtain permission when required. Do not falsely claim someone else's work as your own.

If you believe a video violates your rights, report it to the server administrator rather than engaging in public harassment.

## 8. Follow Moderator Instructions

Moderators and administrators help maintain a safe and enjoyable environment.

Follow reasonable moderation instructions. If you disagree with a decision, contact the administration respectfully through the available reporting or appeal method.

Do not impersonate moderators or interfere with legitimate moderation activities.

## 9. Report Problems

If you encounter harassment, prohibited content, spam, or other violations, report the issue to the server administrator.

Please provide relevant details and avoid retaliating against the person involved. Reports should be made honestly and in good faith.

## 10. Moderation and Consequences

Violations may result in one or more of the following actions, depending on their severity and frequency:

- A reminder or warning.
- Removal of a video, comment, or other content.
- Temporary restrictions or suspension.
- Permanent account suspension or a server ban.
- Referral to the appropriate authorities when required by law.

Serious violations may result in immediate action. Moderation decisions remain subject to applicable law and the server's policies.

## 11. Help Keep Windows 7 Welcoming

Every member contributes to the atmosphere of this community. Be thoughtful about what you post, respect different opinions, support creators, and help make the server enjoyable for everyone.

Our goal is to combine the nostalgia of Windows 7 with a positive, creative, and respectful video-sharing experience.

---

**💙 Windows 7 — A classic feeling, a community for everyone.**

Thank you for being part of the community. Browse, create, share, and enjoy the nostalgia responsibly!

instance.moderation_information:
# Windows 7 — Moderation Information

**Last Updated: October 27, 2026**

Welcome to Windows 7! 💙

Our goal is to maintain a safe, friendly, and enjoyable video-sharing environment inspired by the classic Windows 7 era. Moderation helps protect our users, support creators, and keep the community welcoming.

## 1. How Moderation Works

Windows 7 uses moderation to help enforce our Terms of Service and Code of Conduct. Administrators may review reports, investigate rule violations, and take appropriate action when necessary.

Moderation may involve reviewing videos, thumbnails, titles, descriptions, comments, user profiles, and other publicly available activity on the server.

## 2. What Can Be Reported?

You can report content or behavior that violates our rules, including:

- Harassment, bullying, or targeted abuse.
- Illegal content or credible threats.
- Copyright infringement.
- Spam, scams, or malicious links.
- Impersonation or deceptive activity.
- Privacy violations or the unauthorized sharing of personal information.
- Content that violates the server's Terms of Service or Code of Conduct.

Please provide enough information for the administrator to identify and review the issue.

## 3. Moderation Actions

Depending on the situation, the administration may take actions such as:

- Issuing a warning.
- Removing or restricting access to content.
- Disabling comments or other features where available.
- Temporarily restricting an account.
- Suspending or banning an account.
- Blocking or limiting interactions with other servers when supported and appropriate.

The severity of the violation, its frequency, and the potential harm caused may influence the action taken.

## 4. Reporting Content

If you encounter content that appears to violate our rules, use the available reporting feature or contact the Windows 7 administrator through the server's published contact method.

When submitting a report, include the relevant video or account link, a description of the issue, and any additional details that may help with the review.

Please do not abuse the reporting system or submit knowingly false reports.

## 5. Appeals and Reviews

If you believe a moderation decision was made incorrectly, you may contact the administrator through the available contact method to request a review.

Please explain the decision you are appealing and provide any relevant context. Appeals will be reviewed when reasonably possible, but submitting an appeal does not guarantee that a decision will be reversed.

## 6. Copyright Complaints

Copyright owners or their authorized representatives may contact the administration regarding potentially infringing material.

Please identify the content in question and provide sufficient information to evaluate the complaint. Additional documentation may be required depending on the nature of the request and applicable law.

Content may be restricted or removed when appropriate. Repeat infringement may lead to account restrictions.

## 7. Privacy and Evidence

Reports and moderation investigations may involve information needed to assess a violation, such as content links, relevant messages, or technical records available to the administration.

Information will be handled in accordance with applicable law and the server's privacy policy. Please do not publish private information or attempt to expose another user's identity as a form of retaliation.

## 8. Automated and Federated Moderation

Windows 7 is powered by PeerTube, a federated video-sharing platform. Content and interactions may involve independently operated servers.

Depending on the server configuration, moderation tools may include content reporting, account restrictions, video removal, and blocking other servers. Actions taken by external server administrators are outside our direct control.

Not every report can be resolved immediately, and not every moderation feature may be enabled.

## 9. Administrator Responsibilities

The administration aims to apply the server rules consistently, review reports fairly, protect user privacy, and take reasonable action to address harmful behavior.

Moderation is not intended to prevent respectful disagreement or ordinary criticism. Its purpose is to enforce the published rules and protect the community.

## 10. Contact the Administration

For moderation questions, appeals, or reports, please use the contact information or reporting options published on the Windows 7 server.

Please include relevant details so the administration can understand your concern.

---

**💙 Windows 7 — Keeping the community safe, respectful, and nostalgic.**

Thank you for helping make Windows 7 a better place to watch, share, and discover videos.

This project was created to bring a little of that classic computing feeling into the modern world of online video sharing. With a familiar name and a retro-inspired identity, Windows 7 aims to provide a place where people can discover videos, share their creativity, and enjoy content from across the PeerTube community.

## Our Mission

Our goal is to offer a video-sharing experience that celebrates creativity, nostalgia, and the freedom of sharing videos online. We want Windows 7 to feel like a throwback to a simpler era of computing while benefiting from modern, decentralized technology.

Windows 7 is an independent community project powered by PeerTube. It is not an official Microsoft product and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Microsoft Corporation.

The Windows 7 name is used to communicate the instance's nostalgic theme and identity.

## Thank You for Visiting

Whether you're here to watch videos, share your own creations, or explore the wider world of PeerTube, thank you for being part of Windows 7.

**Windows 7 — The nostalgia of yesterday, the video-sharing experience of today.** 💙
